successors.name: Chu
successors.text: Luo, capital 'Yicheng (宜城)' on the Han River; the body also says 'Luo (today's Luoshan County, Henan Province)'

ledger.x: 11th century BC: Luo is on record.
690: the state of Luo ends in Chu's conquest.

wars.name: Chu conquest of Luo
wars.outcome: Chu conquered Luo in 690 BC; the page says nothing of the campaign or the land afterwards.

certainty.note: No Luo boundary is on the page; the capital moved or the site is disputed (Yicheng or Luoshan); soft throughout.
